title: Federal outlays by category
description: Section three: the donut. Every dollar the federal government spent in one year, split into slices that do not overlap. The slices must sum to totalOutlays, and totalOutlays must match the federal-spending card in receipt.json. Both rules are enforced in scripts/lib/validate.mjs.

totalOutlays.description: Total outlays for the year, in dollars. The slices must add up to this.

categories.description: Rendered in this order, largest first. The order also picks each slice's colour.

name.description: Plain words for what the money does, not the agency's own title.

agency.description: The line as Treasury prints it, so a reader can find it in the source.

amount.description: Dollars. May be negative only inside a combined slice.
